howItWorks.title: Browse China. Buy smarter. We deliver.
howItWorks.subtitle: Use the app to shop from 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods and JD — ChinaSuuq handles the buying, inspection, shipping and delivery to your door in Somalia.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Open the app and explore 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods and JD — in real time, with English and Somali translation built in.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Tap the + button on any product you like, or paste a product link. ChinaSuuq detects the price, images, and variants automatically.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Pick color, size, model and how many units. Compare air (7-14 days) vs sea (25-40 days) shipping and see the total in your local currency.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Complete payment with ZAAD, eDahab, Premier Wallet, bank transfer, or USDT. We confirm every order on WhatsApp before buying.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Our team purchases from verified Chinese suppliers, inspects each item at our China warehouse, and shares photos before shipping.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Choose pickup from our Hargeisa branch or full door delivery. We handle customs, consolidation, and the last mile to your address.
howItWorks.cta: Download the app and start shopping

about.title: A better bridge between Chinese marketplaces and Somaliland buyers.
about.subtitle: We make it simple to discover products, place orders and receive them with confidence — from one app, one team and one clear journey.
about.missionTitle: Built for how people actually buy
about.missionDesc: ChinaSuuq connects Somali and Somaliland customers to the depth of Chinese commerce without forcing them to solve language, supplier, payment and freight problems alone.
about.warehouseDesc: Customers browse the marketplaces themselves. We support the order, purchase from the supplier, receive it at our China warehouse, inspect it and move it through the right shipping lane.
about.value1Desc: Browse 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods and JD inside the product experience.
about.value2Desc: Know what has happened, what is next and where your shipment is.
about.value3Desc: Talk to a Somali-speaking team through WhatsApp and local channels.
about.value4Desc: Inspection, photos and consolidation before your goods leave China.
about.storyDesc: ChinaSuuq is building the everyday infrastructure that makes cross-border shopping feel local: discover in the app, confirm with a human team, then receive in Somaliland.
